purpose: Synthetic software validation only; no tissue realism, anatomical validation or method superiority claim
model: One flat reference boundary on [0,4], bands [-1/2,1/2], slope 1 and clearance 1/100
sites: Two synthetic genes, each with two point sites, one on each side of the source boundary
truth_generator: Triangular PL boundary with peak h at t=2; h is uniform on integer grid [-900,900]/2000, rejecting ownership-clearance ambiguity

scenarios.nominal: Same independent generator in calibration and evaluation
scenarios.evaluation_shift: Replace first record in every fifth evaluation unit with peak 3/4, outside the model band; calibration unchanged
scenarios.calibration_failure: Replace first record in first five calibration units with peak 3/4; force a nonfinite conformal threshold

primary_checks: Every family-and-budget-contained boundary has covered count
All rejected-family records remain in denominators
Count coverage and family coverage reported separately
ranking: Pooled descriptive AUROC and grouped average precision for singleton fragility versus distance; no biological interpretation
statistics: Unit-level simultaneous coverage with approximate Wilson intervals; synthetic units are not donors
